content: Standard Kamal + Phoenix migration pattern: use mix phx.gen.release --docker generated Dockerfile, and run migrations via the release's bin/migrate script from a custom docker-entrypoint before starting bin/server. Kamal's zero-downtime deploy only routes traffic to the new container after it passes health checks, so gating startup on a successful migrate step keeps migrations safely in the deploy path without a separate release_command mechanism (Kamal has no native Heroku-style release_command hook; entrypoint script is the idiomatic equivalent).
